reasons: No test is visible in the packet.
Empty values and missing sources are handled explicitly.

terms.meaning: A small box that floats over the page next to an item.
A way to draw content in a different place in the page structure, here the top level of the page.
A click passing up from an inner element to the elements that contain it.
Kept open after a click, until the user clicks away.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and design notes
sections.what: Brings in React, the portal tool, the external link icon, colours and the link builder. The top comment states the rule that it never invents a source.
sections.why: The imports supply what the component needs, and the comment records the intent.

sections.name: EvidenceField
sections.title: Shape of a datapoint with source
sections.what: Lists the value, source address, publisher, quote and locator for one field.
sections.why: Lets many kinds of data map into the same shape.
sections.watch_out: A value with a source but no content must still show no source, which the code checks separately.

sections.name: hasValue
sections.title: Is there a real value
sections.what: Says yes when the field exists and its value is not null, undefined or blank.
sections.why: Stops empty fields from looking sourced.

sections.name: hasEvidence
sections.title: Is there any source detail
sections.what: Says yes if there is an address, publisher, quote or locator.
sections.why: Lets a field count as sourced when any useful detail exists.
sections.watch_out: A publisher name alone is enough to count as sourced, even without a link or quote.

sections.name: hostOf
sections.title: Short site name from a link
sections.what: Turns a web address into its host name without the www part, or returns the address unchanged if it cannot be read.
sections.why: Used as a readable label when no publisher is given.
sections.watch_out: A badly formed address is shown as raw text, which can look untidy.

sections.name: EvidenceValueProps
sections.title: Settings for the value
sections.what: Lists the field, displayed content, empty label, class name, drawer callback and test id.
sections.why: Lets callers style the value and add the full citation action only where wanted.
sections.watch_out: The full citation button only appears when a drawer callback is passed in.

sections.name: EvidenceValue (part 1)
sections.title: Hover state and popover position
sections.what: Tracks hover and pinned states, measures the value, decides whether the popover goes above or below, and keeps it inside the window edges.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the popover readable near screen edges.
sections.watch_out: The popover width is fixed at 280 pixels here, so a change to the popover width must be made here too.

sections.name: EvidenceValue (part 2)
sections.title: Keeping the popover in place
sections.what: While open, re-measures on scroll and resize, closes a pinned popover on an outside click, and works out the link to the source.
sections.why: Keeps the popover from drifting and from staying open after the user has moved on.
sections.watch_out: Outside clicks are checked across the whole page, so a pinned popover closes on any click elsewhere.

sections.name: EvidenceValue (part 3)
sections.title: Clickable value and source icon
sections.what: Draws the value with a dotted underline that opens on hover, focus or click, and an icon link to the source when a link exists. Enter, Space and Escape also work.
sections.why: Stated in the code: stopping clicks from spreading keeps parent table rows from navigating.
sections.watch_out: Clicks and key presses are stopped from reaching parent elements, so parent handlers will not see them.

sections.name: EvidenceValue (part 4)
sections.title: Popover content for sourced values
sections.what: Draws the popover with the source name (a link when one exists), the quote in italics, and a full citation button when a drawer callback is given.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows the proof beside the value.
sections.watch_out: Long quotes are shown in full, so the popover can become tall.

sections.name: EvidenceValue (part 5)
sections.title: Popover content for no source
sections.what: Shows No source on file, plus a note saying whether a value exists.
sections.why: Makes missing sources visible instead of hiding them.
sections.watch_out: The message does not name which field lacks a source.

summary: Shows a value that opens a small popover with its source (publisher, quote and link) on hover or click, and a muted no-source message when there is no source.
purpose: Makes any number or text in the app traceable to where it came from.
why: The code comment says it is the one universal way to check a datapoint and that it never invents a source.
how: Renders the value. On hover or click it measures the value and opens a popover in the page body. If a source exists, the popover shows publisher, quote and link. Otherwise it shows a no-source message. A small icon opens the source link directly when a web address exists.
inputs: A field holding the value, source address, publisher, quote and locator, plus optional display content, empty label, a drawer callback and a test id.
outputs: The value text, an optional external link icon, and the popover.
risks: Only a value with real content counts as sourced, so a source record with an empty value shows no-source. A publisher name alone counts as a source, even with no link or quote. Position is calculated by hand, so layout changes may shift the popover.
debug: If a popover says no source, check the field's address, publisher and quote. If the popover appears off screen, check the measured position. If clicks on a row do something unexpected, check that the click is being stopped.
